ExperienceOfAiorisis.title: The Experience of Aiorisis
ExperienceOfAiorisis.intro: In our studio, we have created a space that combines safety, quality, and aesthetics, to offer you the best possible experience.
ExperienceOfAiorisis.safetyText1: With a height of 6 meters, our space is ideal for you to perform even the most demanding aerial exercises with absolute comfort.
ExperienceOfAiorisis.safetyText2: Our equipment is certified and new, ensuring the highest quality and safety during your practice. Whether it's aerial yoga, aerial silks, aerial hoop, rope, straps, or flying pole.
ExperienceOfAiorisis.careText: We emphasize cleanliness and care, offering a calm environment. Our classes are small, allowing our instructors to provide personalized guidance according to your needs.
ExperienceOfAiorisis.inviteText: We invite you to explore the possibilities offered by our studio and discover the joy and freedom that our aerial practices offer. Whether you are a beginner or advanced, we are here to support you every step of your journey.

who.title: Who we are
who.text: Aiorisis is an Aerial Arts and Yoga studio based in Thessaloniki, at 42 Artemidos Street.

data.title: What data we collect
data.text: We collect only the personal data that is strictly necessary, such as your name, email address and phone number, which you voluntarily provide through our contact forms or when registering for classes.

processing.title: Purposes of processing
processing.text: We use your personal data exclusively to communicate with you, provide information about our classes and activities, and improve our services.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to access, correct, restrict, transfer and request the deletion of your personal data.
